doc.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Upcoming plans and goodbye
summary: He mentions his Aspen history, upcoming New York club dates with Benny Waters and Japan, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well that’s kind of an upbeat note, and I hope you enjoy your stay here in Aspen.
Oh, always do. I haven’t been here for about three years, but I made the first few parties they had and then missed it.
And you’re off to where after this?
Back to New York, working a week in a club with Ken Peplowski and Michael Moore. And then a week after that at Sweet Basil’s with Benny Waters.
Oh you’re going to do the Benny Waters.
Yeah. The world’s oldest, and strongest saxophone player.
Yeah, he sure is. And after that a few things, going to Japan for a couple of weeks on a little tour, and whatever else happens after that.
Great. Well best of luck to you and thanks for joining us today.
